purpose: Pin one official Federal Reserve nominal broad-dollar surface and exact qualified paired-anchor lifecycle copies before any state-conditioned lifecycle outcome is read.

daily_table.table_title: Nominal Broad Dollar Index - Daily Index
daily_table.official_semantics: The nominal broad dollar index is a weighted average of the foreign exchange values of the U.S. dollar against a broad group of major U.S. trading partners; a higher index value denotes dollar appreciation.

release_schedule.official_schedule: On Mondays at 4:15 p.m. the Federal Reserve Board releases daily bilateral exchange rates and U.S. dollar indexes for the previous business week. A Monday federal holiday shifts release to the following business day.

series_reference.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)

acquisition_corrections.outcome: The HTTP request ended with a remote connection reset before a response artifact existed.
The alternate transfer remained at zero received bytes and was interrupted without an output artifact.
The official H.10 daily table and release-schedule pages downloaded successfully. The daily table was mechanically normalized to one date/value CSV without selecting or reading lifecycle economics.

normalization.transformation: Retain each finite official daily date/value observation in ascending date order. Group by ISO week and use the last finite daily observation only inside the later frozen aggregation.

causal_state_contract.weekly_reference: For each ISO week, use its last finite official daily index observation.
causal_state_contract.state: STRENGTHENING when current weekly last minus prior weekly last is strictly positive; NONSTRENGTHENING when strictly negative; an exact zero invalidates the frozen structural anchor.
causal_state_contract.birth_lookup: For lifecycle server date D, use the latest weekly state whose reference observation date is no later than D minus seven calendar days.
causal_state_contract.availability_reason: The fixed seven-day exclusion makes the selected prior-business-week observation available under the official Monday 16:15 publication schedule, including the following-business-day holiday rule.
causal_state_contract.birth_ownership: The state is assigned once at BIRTH and the matching CLOSE outcome remains owned by that birth state.

immutable_inputs.manifest_rule: Sort name|bytes|uppercase SHA-256 by name, join with LF and SHA-256 UTF-8 without a trailing LF.
